medications.purpose: Reduce LDL‑C and overall cardiovascular risk
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181 / PH46 / NG28 recommends a statin for patients with QRISK ≥10% or metabolic‑syndrome components

medications.dose: 500 mg PO once daily with evening meal, titrate weekly by 500 mg to 1 g twice daily (max 2 g/day)
medications.duration: Titrated to target dose, then Lifelong — review annually
medications.purpose: Improve insulin sensitivity and prevent progression to type 2 diabetes
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 recommends metformin for high‑risk pre‑diabetes (HbA1c 6.0% and BMI ≥30)

medications.dose: 0.25 mg SC weekly, increase every 4 weeks to 0.5 mg then 1 mg weekly as tolerated
medications.purpose: Weight management and additional glycaemic control
medications.nice_justification: NICE PH48 / NG28 recommends GLP‑1 RA for obesity (BMI ≥30) when lifestyle measures insufficient
NICE NG136 recommends ACE‑I as first‑line antihypertensive
NICE NG136 recommends CCB as second‑line agent in combination therapy

interactions_checked.interaction: Amlodipine can increase atorvastatin plasma concentrations (~1.5‑fold), raising risk of myopathy
interactions_checked.action: Start atorvastatin at 20 mg, monitor CK if muscle symptoms develop; avoid higher statin doses without monitoring

contraindications.reason: Contraindicated if eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m² (risk of lactic acidosis)
contraindications.alternative: If eGFR <30, consider a DPP‑4 inhibitor (e.g., sitagliptin) or an SGLT2‑i if no UTI/DKA risk

contraindications.reason: Can worsen glucose tolerance and dyslipidaemia in metabolic syndrome (NICE CG181)
contraindications.alternative: Continue current ACE‑I/CCB regimen; avoid adding thiazide

contraindications.reason: May impair renal function and raise blood pressure in metabolic syndrome (NICE CG181)
contraindications.alternative: Use paracetamol for analgesia; avoid regular NSAIDs

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – assumed ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m² for metformin initiation; obtain serum creatinine/eGFR before starting.
Baseline liver function tests not available – required before initiating atorvastatin; obtain ALT/AST, bilirubin.
Fasting lipid profile and QRISK score missing – needed to confirm dyslipidaemia and quantify CVD risk; order labs and calculate QRISK.
Allergy status unknown – verify no allergy to statins, ACE‑I, or GLP‑1 RA before prescribing.
Blood pressure target confirmed (128/75 mmHg) meets NICE NG136 goal <140/90 mmHg.
Weight and waist circumference not recorded – obtain measurements to monitor response to lifestyle and pharmacologic therapy.
treatment_summary: The plan addresses metabolic syndrome by initiating a statin (atorvastatin) for CVD risk reduction, metformin for pre‑diabetes prevention, and semaglutide for obesity‑related weight loss, while continuing the existing ACE‑I/CCB hypertension regimen. Interactions are minimal; the main caution is monitoring CK with atorvastatin‑amlodipine co‑administration. Metformin use is contingent on eGFR ≥30. Baseline labs (eGFR, LFTs, lipid panel) and QRISK calculation are required before finalising doses. Ongoing monitoring includes lipid profile at 3 months then annually, HbA1c every 3 months until stable, renal function annually, and CK if muscle symptoms arise.
